frames.origin: Authored world/bench center in XY; Z=0 below bench; not an experimental datum
frames.root_transforms: All eight native root transforms are identity. Many annular meshes and curves bake vertices in world coordinates, so their object origin is not the component centroid. Use explicit affordance frames, not object.location alone.
frames.transforms: Inventory gives parent-from-part object transforms; root identity makes them world transforms. Mesh vertices may be offset within object-local frame.
frames.rotation: Inventory quaternion [x,y,z,w]; generator uses Blender XYZ Euler radians for authored poses
frames.affordance_frames: Explicit root-relative frame origins and quaternion rotations; all are authored, unqualified installation frames
frames.glb_export: glTF 2.0, metres, standard Y-up export conversion from Blender Z-up; Blender world (x,y,z) corresponds to glTF (x,z,-y); object IDs preserved
frames.import_gate: Verify units, up-axis, object names, transforms and dimensions after import; no physics/joint import contract exists

inventory.count_rule: Count each asset_id root once; parts, display copies, mesh segments, cameras, lights, operation references and module re-exports do not create new asset roots.

controls.scope: Semantic states and authored visual pose changes only; never operation-completion, hardware, safety or measurement receipts

api.validate: validate(state) returns state or raises ValueError
api.transition: transition(state, event) returns a new validated State; input is unchanged; unsupported or guarded events raise ValueError
api.blender_bind: bind(state) validates then updates authored native objects; repeated binds use captured canonical transforms; no physical backend

grouped_controls: One clamp state controls both lever objects
One lid state controls both paired aperture lids
One reflector_pose shifts both authored reflector assemblies
controls.film_scope: Removal/replacement/tear events change the handling inset only; paired white/black assembly membranes remain intact 1x static visual components
controls.film_damage_scope: Lower handling film has torn_demo visual variant in native Blend only. Upper handling film supports intact/removed, not torn. No tear mechanics.
controls.replacement_identity: State carries separate positive integer lower/upper revisions; replacing a non-intact film increments only its revision. No historical scientific lineage receipt.
controls.optical_scope: Only the authored reference disk is moved; no physical specimen mounting or measured scan
controls.logger_scope: idle/armed_demo text only; no timestamps, readings, acquisition, heater output or hardware connection
controls.joint_scope: Clamps rotate 90 degrees in authored Z about drawn pivots; these are pose variants, not validated mechanical joint limits
controls.exchange_scope: Baseline GLBs are static snapshots; no Python control execution or animation is exported
